channel.title: HAX Schema
channel.description: Documentation for hax-schema, the haxProperties contract that defines how web components integrate with the HAX authoring interface.

item.title: Overview
item.description: hax-schema documents the schema HAX uses to interface with a web component implementing it. A component's haxProperties describe how it appears in the gizmo browser, what settings the editor shows for it, and how HAX should treat it during editing. haxProperties is typically defined in a standalone JSON file, referenced from the element via a static getter: static get haxProperties() { return new URL('./lib/block-quote.haxProperties.json', import.meta.url).href; } See example.json for a compl...

item.description: Core metadata settings Initial metadata settings associated with controls built into the interface: type — is this a block level element OR a grid level element implying it can have things placed inside of it canScale — hide the width scaler which is common canEditSource — should users see the inline view source button hideDefaultSettings — hides the designSystem and textual alignment options commonly present designSystem — can define if accent, primary, card, text (font), and special design ...

item.title: Settings & Input Methods
item.description: Settings provide the editing form fields the user sees. This is a simplified version of JSON Schema and supports property , attribute , or slot as far as what it is mapped to. title and description are shown to the user on the form while inputMethod determines the control rendered. item.title: Hax Hooks
item.description: While haxProperties describes how an element appears in the gizmo browser and how HAX configures it via settings forms, haxHooks lets an element participate in HAX lifecycle / state changes without importing HAX . item.title: Save Options & Demo
item.description: Save options Save options ensure built-in clean up happens when the element is converted to an HTML string. wipeSlot removes any light DOM content the element might have. unsetAttributes is an array of strings which will be removed prior to saving content to an HTML string. item.description: hax-schema is one of several schema specifications in the HAX ecosystem.
